value.title: Phase 1: JavaScript + JSX grammar
value.summary: Wire tree-sitter-javascript, widen the generic value-shape rule, prove with goldens + mutation receipts + a dodo-gogo probe.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; RED before GREEN for T002→T003. Stop and ask the PM (pij-capable-lizard) on anything outside the fence (plan execution_guardrails). Every task closes with its receipt (command + result) written to the execution log.

value.title: Wire tree-sitter-javascript: workspace dep, parsers dep, arch-allowlist line, Language::JavaScript (js|mjs|cjs|jsx), as_str "javascript", grammar(), scan() arm, lib.rs doc, extensions test
value.success: `tree-sitter-javascript = "0.25"` resolves and compiles against tree-sitter 0.26 (prove FIRST with cargo build -p fs3-parsers; on failure stop and report); extensions_map_to_grammars asserts js/MJS/cjs/jsx → JavaScript; arch drift green
value.notes: Paths: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/parsers/Cargo.toml, crates/testkit/arch-allowlist.toml, crates/parsers/src/lib.rs, crates/parsers/src/discovery.rs (exhaustive Language match ~line 170, compiler-forced)

value.title: Fixtures sample.js + sample.jsx with nesting, every binding shape, the ImpactJS pattern and grep-traps; RED goldens + invents-nothing test in fixture_elements.rs
value.success: sample.js covers: function/generator/async declarations, nested function, class decl with constructor/method/static/get+set/#private, class-field arrow, named + anonymous class expression, const/let arrow + function expression bindings, export default function, export const arrow, object-literal shorthand method, `key: function(){}` pairs, `'quoted': () => {}` pair, computed `[k]: fn` (non-element), `exports.h = async () => {}`, `Foo.prototype.bar = function(){}`, `module.exports = function(){}`, ImpactJS `ig.module(...).requires(...).defines(function(){ MyGame = ig.Game.extend({ init: function(){ this.parent(); }, update: function(){} }); })`, and traps ("function"/"class" in strings, comments, template literals; callback arrows as arguments; IIFE; `const n = 42`; `this.x = 5`; destructuring; `handlers[k] = function(){}`; `exports['x'] = () => {}` (subscript left → non-element); `[k]: fn`). sample.jsx: function component, arrow component, class component with render, JSX-heavy body. Expected-tree tables written from the intended contract (not from output) fail before T003; assert tree.has_error == false for both fixtures
value.notes: Paths: crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.js, sample.jsx, crates/parsers/tests/fixture_elements.rs (ADD tests only; existing tables untouched)

value.title: Widen the generic value-shape rule in source.rs: FUNCTION_BINDINGS += field_definition, pair, assignment_expression; value read from an ordered field list (value, right); naming via key/property/left behind a kind guard (left: identifier | member_expression→property; key/property: identifier-kinds | string, unquoted here only); `type` stays last in NAME_FIELDS
value.success: T002 goldens GREEN; no `Language::` branch in source.rs; mutation receipt per widening (field_definition, pair, assignment_expression, `right`, member→property, unquote, the left-kind guard): each removal turns a named golden row red, restored green; a source.rs unit test shows the same rule promoting a pair/assignment in a .ts snippet (generic, not JS-only)
value.notes: Path: crates/parsers/src/source.rs. Do not touch crates/core/src/classify.rs; add a parsers-side test enumerating JS node-kind classify() decisions incl. non-elements (lexical_declaration, variable_declaration, export_statement, import_statement, field_definition, function_expression, arrow_function, jsx_element)

value.title: Cross-language non-regression: prove Rust/Python/TS/TSX goldens byte-unchanged and the full parser suite green
value.success: `git diff b7774df...HEAD -- crates/parsers/tests/fixture_elements.rs` has no removed lines and `git diff b7774df...HEAD -- crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.{rs,py,ts,tsx,md}` is empty; cargo test -p fs3-parsers green; if any existing row had to change, STOP and report it to the PM with the reason (o-prime rider) — never edit an existing expectation silently
